versions.changelog:
- Initial release of btc-price-tick skill.
- Provides real-time BTC price ticks from live exchanges (Kraken, Coinbase Advanced, Hyperliquid).
- No API key, account, or subscription required; uses EVM wallet with USDC on Base.
- Simple x402-authenticated GET request for low-latency BTC price reference.
- Early adopter and loyalty pricing discounts automatically applied.
